channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Florida man arrested over threats to Jewish congressman Jared Moskowitz
item.description: Boca Raton man arrested after allegedly threatening Rep. Jared Moskowitz's life, the latest in a series of threats against the Jewish congressman.

item.title: Saudi Arabia: Two drones launched toward southern region intercepted
item.description: The Saudi-led coalition announced that it intercepted and destroyed two drones launched toward the southern part of the kingdom.

item.title: Podcast | From Noah to Abraham: God's search for man
item.description: What is Midrash? Exploring the world of the Oral Torah.

item.title: Jerusalem: Protesters storm building hosting United Torah Judaism meeting
item.description:
Protesters forced their way into a building in Jerusalem's Beit Yisrael neighborhood where a gathering attended by representatives of the United Torah Judaism party was taking place.
The protesters claimed that MK Yitzhak Pindrus was also present at the event.

item.title: Report: Trump eyes multi-day Iran offensive after midterms
item.description: Report: Trump eyes multi-day Iran offensive after midterms

item.title: Young man seriously injured in stabbing in Hof HaSharon Regional Council
item.description:
A 24-year-old man was seriously injured in a stabbing incident in the Hof HaSharon Regional Council area.
Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics and EMTs evacuated him to Meir Hospital in Kfar Saba.

item.title: Concern in Lebanon: Hezbollah may attempt to destabilize the government
item.description: Concern in Lebanon: Hezbollah may attempt to destabilize the government

item.title: Avi Maoz: We have not held talks with any political party
item.description:
Noam LeIsrael party chairman MK Avi Maoz responded to a Kan 11 News report claiming that Bezalel Smotrich has been holding discreet talks with his party regarding its possible withdrawal from the Knesset race.
"Contrary to the false reports, Noam LeIsrael has not held and is not holding any negotiations with any party in the political arena. We intend to stay in the race until the very end, until our great victory, with God's help," a statement on behalf of Maoz said.

item.title: Caught on camera: Bottle thrown at Prime Minister's convoy at Mahane Yehuda Market
item.description: Bottle thrown toward the Prime Minister's convoy as it moves through Jerusalem's Mahane Yehuda Market. Police launch a search for the suspect.

item.title: Trump signals more strikes on Iran: We may do it a little bit further
item.description: President Trump suggests the US could launch additional strikes against Iran, following reports that Washington and Israel are preparing new military operations.

item.title: Report: Huckabee warns Gaza peace plan lacks staff and resources
item.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee warns that staffing shortages and uncertainty over military support could jeopardize Trump's Gaza peace plan, according to Politico.

item.title: Ahead of elections: Unusual appeal by leading Religious Zionist Rabbis
item.description: Leading Religious Zionist rabbis issue an emergency letter warning against voting for parties that may fail to cross the electoral threshold. "This is a matter of life and death."

item.title: Students recount horrific moments after deadly explosion
item.description: Fifteen-year-old students who witnessed a deadly explosion during a school trip in northern Israel have spoken publicly for the first time about the terrifying moments they treated wounded classmates and tried to save lives.

item.title: There are more Kalashnikovs in Marseille than in Kabul
item.description: There are more Kalashnikovs in Marseille than in Kabul

item.title: Five thoughts about our Mother Rachel
item.description: For thousands of years, our mother Rachel has accompanied us through our trials and suffering, but ultimately, there is hope that the weeping will come to an end.

item.title: 12-year-old Ruth Teller killed in accident in Yitzhar
item.description: Ruth Teller, 12, was critically injured Thursday afternoon while riding an electric bicycle in the community of Yitzhar in Samaria.

item.title: Sderot mayor asks for new neighborhood at Gaza Pioneers site
item.description: Sderot mayor Alon Davidi arrived to offer support to dozens of families and activists from the Nachala Movement who set up camp near the northern perimeter and asked for approval to build a new neighborhood at their encampment.

item.title: Head of Popular Resistance Committees in Khan Yunis eliminated
item.description: IDF and Shin Bet eliminate Ramadan Muhammad Ashahada Diab, who was involved in planning attacks against Israeli forces and rebuilding Hamas' military capabilities in violation of the ceasefire.

item.title: Light a candle for Matriarch Rachel's yahrzeit
item.description: Matriarch Rachel's life touches the hearts of Jewish women generation after generation no matter where they are.

item.title: Levin vows to reshape Supreme Court as historic battle looms
item.description: Justice Minister Yariv Levin says the next Knesset could transform Israel's Supreme Court, advance sovereignty in Judea and Samaria, and determine the future of judicial reform.

item.title: Dramatic footage: Yamam officers rappel from roof to rescue woman threatening to jump
item.description: A woman who barricaded herself inside her apartment and threatened to jump was safely rescued after Yamam officers rappelled from the building's roof to an 11th-floor apartment window.

item.title: Ohad Tal: Israel must settle Gaza and eradicate Hamas
item.description: Religious Zionist MK Ohad Tal calls for Jewish communities in Gaza, warning that Israel cannot afford to leave its enemies without consequences.

item.title: Who will bear the cost of confronting Iran?
item.description: Tehran’s nuclear activities and military network are Israeli security concerns regardless of who occupies the White House. Opinion.

item.title: Trump: Iran trying to drive up oil prices ahead of US midterm elections
item.description: President Trump accuses Tehran of fabricating attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, condemns the killing of Iranian protesters, and vows that Iran will never obtain nuclear weapons.

item.title: Where Is the leader with the vision and courage to apply sovereignty?
item.description: Zionism knew how to move from dream to action, from exile to return, and from settlement to the establishment of the state. Now it is time for sovereignty over all parts of that state. Opinion.

item.title: Ben Gvir defies attorney general over Negev demolitions
item.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has informed Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara that he will continue attending demolitions of illegal structures in the Negev.

item.title: Powerful magnitude 7.0 earthquake in Tibet
item.description: A magnitude 7 earthquake struck the Nagchu region of Tibet, the German Geological Survey (GFZ) reported. The epicenter was about 10 kilometers below the surface, according to the report. There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.

item.title: IDF: Gunfire near Homesh was not a terror attack
item.description:
Following the report of a shooting in the area of Homesh, an initial inquiry indicates that an Israeli civilian identified a suspected armed individual and heard gunfire that was not related to a terror attack. Furthermore, the civilian fired toward the source of the gunfire.
IDF soldiers were dispatched to the scene and are conducting searches for armed individuals in the area.

item.title: Israel sanctions Lebanese fuel company for supplying fuel to Hezbollah
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz approved sanctions against Coral Oil after Israeli authorities found that the company supplied diesel and gasoline to a Hezbollah-owned fuel distributor.

item.title: Shooting in Homesh area: No casualties reported
item.description: Following reports of a shooting in the Homesh area of ​​Samaria, there are no reports of casualties at this stage. IDF forces were called to the scene and the circumstances of the incident are being investigated.
